title: fix_signal direct-invocation path assumes signal is in index.md
description: When fix_signal is invoked with a signal_id, the skill instructs the agent to read index.md and find the row whose Signal ID matches. In this run, signal a1000002-0529-4000-8000-000000000002 existed in the catalogue directory but had not been registered in index.md. The skill provided no fallback for this case, requiring the agent to infer the file path from the user's IDE selection context rather than from the index.
proposed_resolution: Update fix_signal.skill.md Signal Resolution Mode to add a fallback: if the signal_id is not found in index.md, call list_directory on .moeb/signals/catalogue/ and search each .signal.json file for a matching signal_id field. Proceed once found, or fail with a clear message if not found in any file.

title: fix_signal MCP tool returns 84.8KB output requiring external file reader
description: The mcp__moeb__fix_signal tool returned 84.8KB of content (the full skill prompt including README, specification index, and rubric tables). The Claude Code harness persisted this to an external file and provided only a 2KB preview. Reading the full content required the non-moeb Read and PowerShell tools, causing a moeb-tool-origin rubric failure. The large output is caused by embedding the full .moeb/README.md content (with the complete specification index) directly in the prompt.
proposed_resolution: Reduce fix_signal tool output to only the session context fields (run_id, run_file_path, signal_id) and the skill/rubric content, excluding the pre-loaded README.md content from the returned prompt text. The skill already notes that README.md is pre-loaded; it does not need to be echoed in the MCP tool return value.

title: No moeb tool for loading deferred MCP tool schemas
description: When executing fix_signal via the Claude Code MCP interface, moeb tool schemas are deferred and must be loaded via the external ToolSearch tool before any moeb tool can be called. There is no moeb equivalent for this operation. Every fix_signal invocation in MCP mode incurs at least two ToolSearch calls to load required tool schemas, causing a guaranteed moeb-tool-origin rubric failure before any moeb tool is ever called.
proposed_resolution: Add a list_tools or describe_tools moeb tool that returns the JSON schema for one or more named moeb tools by name. Agents can call this tool to discover parameter shapes without needing an external schema-loading mechanism.

title: fix_signal should register unindexed signals in index.md before picking up
description: Signal a1000002-0529-4000-8000-000000000002 (Deprecate patch_file as the default agent write path) existed in the catalogue but was absent from .moeb/signals/index.md. The fix_signal skill has no step to detect and correct this gap. An unindexed signal is invisible to future Phase 1 scans, meaning it would never be automatically selected for resolution without direct invocation by signal_id.
proposed_resolution: Add a Phase 2b to fix_signal.skill.md: after locating the signal file (whether via index or catalogue scan), check whether the signal_id appears in index.md. If absent, append the missing row to the index table before proceeding to Phase 3.
